questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and clearly holds three pens in a row.
The left and right pens have their dark caps at the bottom. The middle pen has a pointed tip at the bottom, indicating it is oriented oppositely (tip down vs cap down) or is uncapped.
All pens appear to have translucent barrels and black/dark components, sharing the same general color scheme.
The middle pen shows a pointed writing tip at the bottom, while the outer two pens show blunt capped ends. This indicates a missing cap or wrong orientation.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the video without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is oriented differently than the outer two pens; the outer pens have their caps facing down, while the middle pen has its writing tip facing down (or is missing its cap), violating the condition that all pens must point the same direction and be mutually consistent.

description: One pen is missing its cap (variant).
